name: Fantasy Football GM
tagline: A four-desk front office for start/sit, waivers and trades
description: Runs your fantasy league like a head office with four desks: waiver wire, player usage, trade market and injury watch. Every recommendation is weighted for how your league scores, and it will not submit a move - start, bid or trade - until you give the go-ahead.
author: mattkim1
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
